good_thing: (Pueblo, Colorado): Ash, a fledgling flammulated owl displaced by the Aspen Acres fire, was released into the wild on August 26 after about six weeks at the Raptor Center in Pueblo. A firefighter had rescued him in July at just one ounce; he was released at Manitou Experimental Forest alongside other flammulated owls headed south.
current_or_history: On August 28, 1898, New Bern pharmacist Caleb Bradham renamed his popular soda-fountain drink Pepsi-Cola. Until then, it had been called Brad’s Drink, a notably local name for a beverage that would travel far beyond North Carolina.
tiny_fact: A day on Venus is longer than its year: it takes 243 Earth days to rotate once and 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun. Because Venus rotates backward, the Sun would rise in the west there.
thought: You do not have to solve the whole horizon to take the next kind step.
